nodes.label: Crowdin Translation Management
nodes.rationale: Crowdin project ID 878122 manages community translations. Source: lib/l10n/app_en.arb. Translations sync to lib/l10n/app_{two_letters_code}.arb. Uses update_as_unapproved to preserve existing translations when English strings change.

nodes.label: Localization System (ARB + flutter gen-l10n)
nodes.rationale: Uses Flutter's built-in gen-l10n tool. ARB files live in lib/l10n/ with app_en.arb as the template. Generated Dart files go to lib/l10n/generated/. Output class is AppLocalizations. Crowdin is used for community translation management.

nodes.label: Aurora Music App
nodes.rationale: Android-focused Flutter music player (version 1.3.6+22) targeting on-device playback with Material You design. minSdk 29 (Android 10), targetSdk 35. Licensed under GNU GPLv3. Package name: aurora_music_v01.

nodes.label: Background Audio Playback
nodes.rationale: Uses audio_service for Android media session and background service + just_audio as the playback engine. Supports gapless playback, playback speed, shuffle, repeat, and sleep timer. Requires FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK and WAKE_LOCK.

nodes.label: Dynamic Color Theming
nodes.rationale: Material You dynamic color via dynamic_color package plus palette_generator for artwork-based color extraction. Blurred backgrounds and artwork caching for visual richness.

nodes.label: Local Library Scanning
nodes.rationale: Scans device MediaStore via on_audio_query. Supports songs, albums, artists. Requires READ_MEDIA_AUDIO (Android 13+) or READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Android 12-).

nodes.label: Metadata Editor
nodes.rationale: Tag reading/writing via audiotags. Auto-tag suggestions from Deezer/iTunes. On Android 10+ uses MediaStore ContentResolver via platform channel — no MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE required.

nodes.label: Smart Recommendations
nodes.rationale: Suggestions based on listening history using time-of-day and day-of-week patterns. Stored and queried locally.

nodes.label: Synced Lyrics (LRCLIB)
nodes.rationale: Fetches timed lyrics from LRCLIB API over HTTP. Caches results locally. Full-screen lyrics view with sync offset controls. Batch download tool for offline use.

nodes.label: Provider + Services Architecture
nodes.rationale: App uses Provider for global state management and a dedicated services layer for business logic (audio, lyrics, caching, suggestions, metadata, Bluetooth). UI is split into screens (high-level flows) and widgets (reusable components). Features organized under lib/features/, shared code in lib/shared/, infrastructure in lib/core/.
